name: find-one-capture
source: local a,b,c=string.find("a12", "(%d+)"); assert(a==2 and b==3 and c=="12")

name: find-two-captures
source: local a,b,c,d=string.find("a12", "(%a)(%d+)"); assert(a==1 and b==3 and c=="a" and d=="12")

name: find-not-found
source: local a,b,c=string.find("abc", "z"); assert(a==nil and b==nil and c==nil)

name: find-no-captures
source: local a,b,c=string.find("abc", "a"); assert(a==1 and b==1 and c==nil)

name: find-position-capture
source: local a,b,c=string.find("abc", "()b"); assert(a==2 and b==2 and c==2)

name: unpack-four
source: local a,b,c,nextByte=string.unpack("BBB","abc"); assert(a==97 and b==98 and c==99 and nextByte==4)

name: find-alias
source: local find=string.find; local a,b,c=find("a12", "(%d+)"); assert(a==2 and b==3 and c=="12")

name: unpack-field
source: local object={read=string.unpack}; local value,nextByte=object.read("B","a"); assert(value==97 and nextByte==2)

name: find-wrapper
source: local function find() return string.find("a12", "(%d+)") end; local a,b,c=find(); assert(a==2 and b==3 and c=="12")

name: unpack-wrapper
source: local function read() return string.unpack("B","a") end; local a:number,b:number=read(); assert(a==97 and b==2)

name: nonfinal-unpack
source: local a,b,c=string.unpack("BB","ab"),9; assert(a==97 and b==9 and c==nil)
